In view of the above, the Respondent has prayed that the aforesaid statutory notifications and policy communications have materially impacted the admissibility, necessity and recoverability of FGD-related capitalisation and supplementary charges in respect of BTPS-A and therefore require due consideration before any determination of tariff or approval of cost recovery is undertaken in terms of the present Petition. The Commission may take judicial cognisance of the said subsequent developments and adjudicate the captioned Petition in conformity with the prevailing regulatory and policy framework, so as to render a complete, just and effective decision in the matter.

124. We further note that the present I.A. was filed after the matter had been reserved for order. In view of this, no separate hearing on the said I.A. is considered necessary. Nevertheless, we have taken cognisance of the I.A. and have duly considered the submissions made therein, including the Minutes of Meetings (MoM) placed on record. The directions issued in this order are, accordingly, based on the consideration of the said I.A., and the MoM shall form part of the record.

126. Accordingly, I.A. No. 61/2026 stands disposed of along with the present petition. The parties are, however, granted liberty to approach the Commission in the event of any dispute arising in this regard.

128. Petition No. 361/MP/2023 along with I.A. No. 61/2026 is disposed of in terms of the above.
